description: Declared mutants of render targets, texture formats and the one clip-from-world value (render-pipeline declaration section 13, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a1; T1 to T7; camera CM-3, CM-5; render RD-3, RD-11). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The gt- mutants need a GPU (label gpu). Queue2d and Queue3d taking the one value are guarded by p2-view-ignored and p3-view-ignored (render_mutations.json, rewritten to the new code), not repeated here. Not added (with the reason): UpdateCameras' explicit order after TransformPropagate (the kernel already runs an undeclared conflicting pair in registration order and camera's row depends on transform, so the propagation runs first without it; a mutant that drops the order survives every case, run 2026-11-27, so it is stated as visibility's is and not counted); a target's own depth texture (with every target the main target's size in the tests a shared depth draws the same, so no case could kill it; RC-A1-3 names when it matters); camera_render skipping a camera whose target maps to nothing (the same decision as PassTargetOf's nullopt, rt-pass-target-raw, criterion 1); the backend's format support check (Lavapipe and Metal take both formats; refusing one is not reachable without a driver that lacks it); the Programmer Errors of a zero target size and of an update of a target (asserts, guarded by their GYO_CHECK_ASSERTS cases; the README keeps assert mutants for contracts a test cannot reach otherwise).
